Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Sanjay - 28 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Pallavi - 58 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Kavita - 28 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Sanjay stands by the road. Pallavi and Kavita stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Sanjay rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Sanjay: "Show me too!"

[Sanjay takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Pallavi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
